entries.en: Hope I remember my low-gravity combat training.
Damn geth have us at a disadvantage, Commander. Synthetic bastards don't even need space suits out here.
A spacewalk up the side of the Citadel? You certainly like to keep things interesting, Commander.
Never thought I'd see the Citadel from this angle, Shepard.
Gravity's not too strong here, Shepard. If you ever get a chance to blast your target off into space, do it. Just watch 'em float away.
Don't worry about me, Shepard. Quarians are used to making spacewalks. It comes in handy if we have to make repairs on our ships.
